study_sample_descriptor.sample_quote: [Methodology: Data collection] "This study collected data from FSEs in international hotels in Taiwan to test the research hypotheses. There were 79 international hotels in Taiwan in September 2019 (Tourism Bureau, 2019). The human resource managers of all 79 hotels were contacted and asked if they would be willing to help collecting the data for this research; 25 agreed to do so. Thirty questionnaires were sealed in envelopes and sent to those human resource managers at 25 international hotels (750 sealed questionnaires in total). Then the mangers distributed questionnaires to their FSEs and FSEs returned the completed questionnaires in another sealed envelope to his/her managers for sending them back to us. The incentives of gift certificates (150 NTDs) were provided to thank to respondents of this study and a 1000 NTDs worth gift certificate was given to each manager for appreciating his/her kind assistance. Research data were collected from October 15th to December 15th in 2019. 382 valid samples were collected, for a response rate of 50.9%. The responses of the late respondents (51 persons) were compared to those of the early respondents (332 persons) to examine non-response bias. The results showed no differences in any variable and hence non-response bias is unlikely to be a problem (Armstrong & Overton, 1977). The final sample consisted of 249 female (65.2%) and 133 male (34.8%) staff. Of these, 29.3% were below 30 years of age, and 23.8% were aged 41–50. Most respondents were under 5 years of tenure (39.5%) and 51.8% had a university degree."

table_matrix.table_title: Table 2. Means, standard deviations, and correlations.
table_matrix.cot_reasoning: Table 2 (p. 426) displays a lower triangular zero-order Pearson correlation matrix with means and standard deviations for 7 substantive variables among N = 382 frontline service employees. Diagonal entries contain composite reliabilities or unities (omitted). Footnote ** indicates p < 0.01; * indicates p < 0.05. Pruning: No demographic control variables (e.g., age, gender, tenure) are present in the correlation matrix. All 12 pairings between the 3 COBSB sub-dimensions (External Representation, Internal Influence, Service Delivery) and the 4 substantive non-BS constructs (Role Conflict, Role Ambiguity, Proactive Personality, Employee Creativity) are extracted.
